# Subsample

# Impute

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_impute_simple(mad_bor_g1000_sum, method = "random")
gt_set_imputed(mad_bor_g1000_sum, TRUE)
```


#LD clumping

```{r}
show_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)$chromosome <- as.integer(show_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)$chromosome)

show_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum) <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% show_loci() %>% arrange(chr_int,position)

to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(mad_bor_g1000_sum, thr_r2 = 0.5, size = 50, return_id = TRUE)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum%>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
```


Here - we previously had issues with 'Error: 'pos.chr' is not sorted.'


# PCA

```{r}
random_pca <- gt_pca_randomSVD(mad_bor_g1000_sum)

pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca$u)

#big_random_pca <- gt_pca_randomSVD(imputed_data)
#auto_pca <- gt_pca_autoSVD(imputed_data) # there's still an error here...
```


```{r}
main2 <- ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y= V2, colour = mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + #
  labs(title = "PCA", x = "PC 1", y = "PC 2", colour = NULL)+ 
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face="bold"),legend.text = element_text(size = 5))
main2
```

# Subsample

```{r}
subsample <- function(x){
  
  if(nrow(x)<=30){
    return(x)
  } else {
    sample_n(x, size = 30)
  }
  
}

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  group_modify(~ subsample(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()
  
mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population) %>% count() 

```


```{r}
partial_pca <- gt_pca_partialSVD(mad_bor_g1000_sum)

pcs <- as.data.frame(partial_pca$u)

main2 <- ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y= V2, colour = mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + #
  labs(title = "PCA", x = "PC 1", y = "PC 2", colour = NULL)+ 
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face="bold"),legend.text = element_text(size = 5))
main2
```
